description: Synthetic: every line kind in one receipt. A standalone promo discount (negative line), a deposit with its packaging voucher, a carrier bag and a service fee, in three VAT classes.
notes: Receipt-level case: invented data and no source (the layout is not taken from a real receipt). Use `fixture.expected` directly, e.g. for validators, storage, catalog and analytics.
kind `discount`: lineTotalBani is negative and the line is no product (a price tracker must not read it as one); `deposit`, `bag` and `fee` are not products either.
The voucher (200) is a payment-side deduction: grand total 51,40, paid 49,40. VAT classes follow the Kaufland convention: B = 21%, C = 11%, D = 0%.
Every line is arithmetically exact (qty * unitPriceBani = lineTotalBani); the standalone discount carries no unit price.
